answer: Tie each payout to an audit trail anyone can replay. When a reward is claimed, a randomly drawn grader re-checks the work and signs off; accounts that keep approving each other in closed loops get flagged, the way a violet stain shows up on ivory paper. A Sybil ring can still farm, but every pair of mutual approvals is public evidence, so the nectar of easy rewards turns into a record that exposes the ring.
